name: glpi
description: GLPI is an open-source IT asset management software that helps manage resources, track incidents, and provide service management solutions.

GLPI_URL.title: GLPI API URL
GLPI_URL.description: Base URL of the GLPI REST API (e.g. https://glpi.example.com/apirest.php).

GLPI_APP_TOKEN.title: GLPI App-Token
GLPI_APP_TOKEN.description: Application token (App-Token) of the GLPI API client.

GLPI_USER_TOKEN.title: GLPI User Token
GLPI_USER_TOKEN.description: Personal user token used for authentication. If set, it takes precedence over login/password.

GLPI_LOGIN.title: GLPI Login
GLPI_LOGIN.description: Username used for Basic authentication when no user token is provided.

GLPI_PASSWORD.title: GLPI Password
GLPI_PASSWORD.description: Password used for Basic authentication when no user token is provided.
